unemployment.note: State formulas belong in data/rules-registry.json (ui.stateBenefits). Until that table is sourced, this national placeholder is used and every estimate is marked unverified.
unemployment.source: U.S. Department of Labor, Significant Provisions of State Unemployment Insurance Laws

healthAfterJobLoss.note: The marketplace benchmark from data/healthcare.json with the credit at the reduced income (unemployment benefits only), or COBRA when entered. COBRA defaults to the benchmark times this factor.
